description: This is a Java class file named Assertions.java that provides custom assertion methods for testing persistence-related functionalities, specifically for testing lists with detailed index and element information and for retrying assertions with delays.

classes.name: Assertions
classes.description: Final utility class providing custom assertions for testing persistence, including list assertions with index info and await-based retries.

methods.name: assertListWithIndexInfo
methods.description: Asserts a list by applying a provided element assertion, with detailed error messages indicating the index and elements involved.

methods.name: retryOnAssertionError
methods.description: Retries a given assertion Runnable multiple times with specified delay until it succeeds or the maximum wait time is exceeded.
